_comment: Which of agentY's skills (skills/) are copied into the agentY-mcp Claude Code plugin by scripts/sync_plugin_skills.py. 'exclude' lists host-only skills with the reason; 'notes' lists skills that ARE shipped but mention a host-only tool in part of their text.

exclude.orchestrator-skills: A folder of sub-skills (canvas-refine-loop, remotion, self-extension) for the agentY host's own orchestrator: they use refine_canvas_until, create_skill and the panel. It has no SKILL.md of its own.
exclude.canvas-layout: Drives the agentY panel's canvas tools (arrange_canvas, group_canvas_nodes, auto_group_canvas, save_canvas_workflow, load_tools); the MCP server has none of them.
exclude.hook-pipeline: Builds hook chains with the host's canvas-graph tools (edit_canvas_graph, delete_canvas_nodes, get_canvas_node); the MCP server only reads the selection and sets node parameters.
exclude.spawn-subagent: Uses the host's spawn_subagent / run_planner and signal_workflow_ready. A Claude Code session delegates with its own subagents (see agents/).
exclude.batch-handoff: Hands a batch to the host's Executor with signal_workflow_ready / upload_image_multiple. In MCP use run_variants, execute_workflows_batch or start_batch_job.
exclude.image-batch: Writes multiprompt.json for the host pipeline's batch hand-off (see batch-handoff); nothing in the MCP server reads it.

notes.assemble-new-workflow: Ends with the host's signal_workflow_ready; over MCP, finish with validate_workflow and execute_workflow.
notes.partner-run: Mentions the host's signal_workflow_ready hand-off; partner_run itself runs the node.
notes.story-synopsis: Mentions signal_workflow_ready; the writing is plain text over MCP.
notes.video-gemini-motionpromptgeneration: Mentions signal_workflow_ready; use execute_workflow over MCP.
notes.camera-move-control: Names run_world_builder, a host tool; over MCP build the world with atlas_create_world.
notes.dcc-destruction-houdini: Names show_in_panel / load_tools (host panel); the dcc_build part works over MCP.
notes.model-from-reference: Names show_in_panel / load_tools (host panel) and blender__* tools (the Blender MCP server, only when it is connected).
notes.seedance-reference: Names check_node_types (host); use get_node_schema over MCP.
notes.custom-node-from-github: Names file_read (host); read_text_file does the same over MCP.
notes.image-downsize: Names file_read (host); read_text_file does the same over MCP.
